title: Entanglement entropy of ground states of the Landau Hamiltonian on the half-plane
summary: We study the entanglement entropy of ground states of a Hamiltonian defined on a domain with a boundary. Surprisingly, boundary conditions can change the spectrum and the nature of the spectrum drastically but not the leading behaviour of the entanglement entropy. As is well-known, the Landau Hamiltonian on the full plane has pure point spectrum (the infinitely degenerate Landau levels) and ground states display a so-called strict area law.
